title: Labor Rate says Varies by location when another location differs
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'.
  • Use a client with two locations, location 1 and location 2, and be signed in at location 1.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on Default for work orders and Default for Part Sales, with one labor rate at location 1 (for example Heavy Duty) and a different one at location 2 (for example Light Duty).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Labor Rate reads location 1's rate (for example Heavy Duty).
  • Under it the card reads "Varies by location".
